variants.prompt: Freya lounges on a plush, velvet chaise in an opulent, dimly lit boudoir, the antique furniture and draping curtains creating an air of mystery and seduction as she reclines in a Victorian-style corset and shorts, one leg bent at the knee, the other extended along the cushions, her gaze upturned and lips slightly parted in a coy invitation, the shot rendered in deep shadows and highlights to draw the viewer's eye to her alluring form.
